upgrades.name: Tidewise
upgrades.desc: You have sold this fish before. You know what it is worth.

upgrades.name: Quick Hands
upgrades.desc: Your hands know the reel before you pick it up.

upgrades.name: Steady Line
upgrades.desc: The line has broken here already. Not this time.

upgrades.name: Patient Float
upgrades.desc: You look at the float a breath before it moves.

upgrades.name: Second Sight
upgrades.desc: Some of them remember you too.

upgrades.name: Old Habits
upgrades.desc: Cast, wait, strike. You could do it asleep. Perhaps you are.

upgrades.name: Deep Pockets
upgrades.desc: Coins in a coat you do not remember filling.

upgrades.name: Mara's Ledger
upgrades.desc: "I must have quoted you already," says Mara, frowning at her own handwriting.

upgrades.name: Lamp Minder
upgrades.desc: There was always another pot in the shed. Wasn't there?

upgrades.name: Warm Lanterns
upgrades.desc: The lanterns stay lit a little longer than the oil should allow.
